verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV supports conditional logic within verification templates (e.g., run a check only if another fails or based on risk/country) and emits distinct webhook events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) that downstream systems can act on, which together constitute a limited form of event-triggered automation confined to the verification flow itself. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/automation builder outside the verification template, documented examples of webhook events triggering arbitrary external actions, and independent/hands-on evidence of this automation working end-to-end.
